rationale: Pins the three `references` rules the corpus never exercises. `permits` and `record_pattern` were already pinned; `switch_pattern` was pinned by NOTHING — it fires on neither grails-core nor clojure (both predate pattern matching), so it had no differential coverage and no fixture, i.e. no coverage at all. A rule that cannot fire on the corpus and is not pinned is a rule whose behaviour is whatever it currently happens to be. All three were probed working on the pinned grammar before being pinned: sealed/permits yields the permitted subtypes, a record deconstruction pattern yields the record type, and a type pattern yields the bound type, with and without a `when` guard.
